core_obligations: Show that a family alpha of r-cycles on fibres of X/S with S locally Noetherian and f locally of finite type is a relative r-cycle if and only if every base change g_i^*alpha along a h covering {g_i : S_i to S} is (proof lines 989-1019). Forward direction: lemma-relative-cycle-functoriality (tag 0H51) gives that base changes of relative cycles are relative (proof lines 990-991). Converse: let g : S' to S be a morphism from the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring; replace S by S', X by its base change, and alpha by g^*alpha, using flat-lemma-h (tag 0ETY) that base changes of h coverings are h coverings, reducing to the case S a valuation ring with closed point 0 and generic point eta where one must show sp_{X/S}(alpha_eta) = alpha_0 (proof lines 992-997); since an h covering is a V covering by definition, topologies-lemma-refine-qcqs-V (tag 0ETN) provides an index i and a specialization s' leading to s in S_i with g_i(s') = eta and g_i(s) = 0 (proof lines 1002-1005); by properties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-specialization-dvr (tag 054F) find h : S' to S_i from a valuation ring mapping eta' to s' and 0' to s, and set alpha' = h^* g_i^* alpha, which satisfies sp_{X'/S'}(alpha'_{eta'}) = alpha'_{0'} by assumption (proof lines 1006-1011); the composite g = g_i composed with h is induced by an extension of discrete valuation rings, so lemma-specialization-extension (tag 0H4K) makes the specialization maps compatible with the base change maps on fibres, and since the base change map Z_r(X_0) to Z_r(X'_{0'}) on the closed fibres is injective as discussed in section-relative-fields (tag 0H4E), the identity descends to sp_{X/S}(alpha_eta) = alpha_0 (proof lines 1012-1018).
proof_roadmap: Forward direction by functoriality of the relative cycle property (proof lines 990-991).
Reduce the converse to testing against valuation rings, keeping the h covering under base change (proof lines 992-997).
Refine the h covering as a V covering to find a member carrying a specialization over the two points, and realize it by an internal valuation ring map (proof lines 1002-1011).
Transport the specialization identity along the DVR extension and descend by injectivity of base change over fields (proof lines 1012-1018).
